terrain.caveat: FABDEM uses model-based removal of forest and building height biases; it is not a surveyed local DTM. Resampling to 10 m does not create new elevation detail. Surface is this ground plus footprint building heights once.
terrain.download_method: HTTP range extraction of exact ZIP member; ZIP CRC checked

unknown_buildings: Keep height null; footprint only in viewer, footprint blocks simulation. No synthetic heights.
embankments: Only mapped OSM ways. Crest height is the surface raster; no invented crest uplift. Missing mapping is not evidence of absence.

terrain_comparison.use: Comparison only; never used as simulation ground

surface_definition: FABDEM ground + building height raster, added exactly once
datum_calibration_note: Calibrate against FABDEM before computing flood runs; any prior Copernicus-ground calibration is invalid.
